review.notes: Full review. Worker's automatic checks all passed; dependency check: 200 roadmaps, 2195 edges, 0 problems. Elaboration: 120 sorry warnings, no other message; #check @ for all 179 declarations, binders intact; one-tactic probe closed 7 sorries plus 2 congrArg corollaries. Findings: R01 Grossencharacter.unitaryCancelling has no planned input for infinite-order characters (or for K = Q twists), on which the unconditional angular-character nonvanishing of section 7.4 rests; R02 the overview, section 6.6 and a Lean docstring say the full completion reflects about 1/2 + sigma against the inverse, refuted by N over Q at s = 5. Previous review: R02 repaired; R01, R03 and R04 partly repaired.
